shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Runs up the right wall to the Morgue for the skill shot. Overshoot it and the ball carries into the Suspect Shakedown lane and dies in the bumpers instead.

shots.name: Morgue / AV Lab
shots.notes: One sinkhole with two identities. Entered from the plunge lane or the lower flippers it is the Morgue; entered from the right off the mini flipper it pays AV Lab awards instead.

shots.name: Microscope Loop
shots.notes: A horseshoe you can enter from either side, with a magnet inside that grabs the ball for study. This is the lock for Microscope Multiball and the shot that lights Evidence everywhere else.

shots.name: Bullet Target (Microscope)
shots.notes: The fifth bullet, sitting between the two entrances of the Microscope horseshoe.

shots.name: Bullet Targets (Upper Right)
shots.notes: A pair below the sinkhole, both facing left. These are mini-flipper targets — the lower flippers cannot reach them cleanly.

shots.name: Right Loop
shots.notes: The wide loop up the right side. Each trip adds 1K to the pop bumper value, and it is a quadruple jackpot shot deep in Microscope Multiball.

shots.name: Fingerprint Spinner
shots.notes: A long shot from either lower flipper that turns hard left into the Suspect Shakedown lane and on into the bumpers. Spins build Fingerprint Frenzy at 3K a turn.

shots.name: Skull Ramp
shots.notes: The only ramp on the machine, threaded past the right edge of the Centrifuge. Lamps at its mouth tell you whether it is feeding a Skull lock or just returning the ball to the right flipper.

shots.name: Centrifuge
shots.notes: The spinning disc, reachable from either lower flipper. It counts spins toward its own multiball, then converts into a ball lock with an up-post in the entrance.

shots.name: Bullet Target (Centrifuge)
shots.notes: Stands just left of the Centrifuge entrance. Easy to clip by accident on a wide Centrifuge shot.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Three bumpers in their own enclosed pocket, fed by both spinner lanes and by the Skull releasing its locks. The only way out is down to the mini flipper.

shots.name: The Skull
shots.notes: Rises out of the playfield to hold locked balls in its eye sockets. Released balls run the same path back through the gate, the bumpers and down to the mini flipper.

shots.name: Suspect Shakedown Spinner
shots.notes: The left spinner and the mouth of the looping Shakedown lane. Fifty spins finishes the suspect's face and starts the mode.

shots.name: Mini Flipper
shots.notes: Sits above the Lab saucer and fires diagonally across to the top right. Your only reliable route to the AV Lab and the right-facing bullet targets.

shots.name: Lab Saucer
shots.notes: Above the left flipper, a third of the way up. Lab awards, the sixth Ballistics bullet and the CSI bonus are all collected here.

shots.name: Bullet Target (Lab)
shots.notes: The first bullet, immediately left of the Lab saucer.

shots.name: DNA Drop Targets
shots.notes: Three drops down the far left rail. Clearing the bank is worth 25K a target and lights a Lab award at the saucer.

shots.name: Left Inlanes
shots.notes: Two of the three lanes that spell C-S-I. The flipper alignment is shifted right of centre to make room for them.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: The third C-S-I lane. Lane change with the flipper buttons before the ball gets here.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Can be lit for Special by an AV Lab or Lab award.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: The other half of the outlane Special. Nothing else lives here — this machine drains fast and hard.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Skull ramp, the Fingerprint spinner, the Centrifuge and the right loop.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Lab saucer, the DNA drops, the Shakedown spinner and the Centrifuge.

goals.title: Morgue Skill Shot
goals.summary: Plunge up the right wall into the Morgue sinkhole. It pays 500K the first time, and every later lit Morgue collection in the game is worth 100K more than the one before it.

steps.action: Plunge with control up the right wall
steps.detail: Too much power and the ball runs past the hole into the Shakedown lane and the bumpers instead. The value you set here keeps climbing all game, so collect the Morgue whenever it is lit.

goals.title: AV Lab Awards
goals.summary: The same sinkhole becomes the AV Lab when you enter it from the right off the mini flipper. In single-ball play it hands out 250K, Light Special at the outlane, Light Extra Ball at the saucer, or a points award that starts at 325K and grows 25K each time.

steps.action: Get fed to the mini flipper
steps.detail: Everything that goes through the bumper pocket comes out at the mini flipper.
This is the only dependable way in from the right, and it is what turns the Morgue into the AV Lab.
Light Extra Ball still has to be cashed at the Lab saucer, so do not leave it sitting.

goals.title: Start Skull Multiball
goals.summary: Shoot the Skull ramp to light a lock and watch the Skull rise, then shoot it again to put a ball in an eye socket. Two locked balls start the multiball. Each later Skull Multiball demands more ramp shots to light each lock.

steps.detail: The lamps at the ramp entrance are the only place this is announced.
The Skull rises out of the playfield and takes the ball into an eye socket.
With both eyes loaded the balls release down through the gate and the bumpers.

goals.title: The Four Skull Levels
goals.summary: Skull Multiball is a ladder, not a free-for-all. Six yellow-arrow shots at 250K, then six bullet targets at 500K, then a 750K Skull shot you have to repeat with the second ball inside five seconds, then the Morgue and right loop for a million each.

steps.action: Level one: clear six yellow arrows
steps.detail: 250K apiece. The arrows tell you exactly where to go.
500K each. The right-hand pair still needs the mini flipper.

steps.action: Level three: double up on the Skull
steps.detail: 750K, then a second 750K if you land the other ball there within five seconds.

steps.action: Level four: Morgue and right loop
steps.detail: A million each, and that completes Skull Multiball. Survive and the ladder starts over at level one.

goals.title: Centrifuge Multiball
goals.summary: Feed the disc and let it spin the ball. Each spin is 100 points and counts down toward multiball — roughly a hundred spins the first time, more every time after. At zero the Centrifuge turns into a lock, and hitting it again raises the post and auto-plunges a second ball.
goals.reward: Two-ball multiball with a built jackpot

steps.detail: Any lower flipper reaches it. The display counts down the spins you still owe.
The up-post traps the ball and a second one is served.
Every switch you hit with the live ball adds 250, and pumping the flippers spins the trapped ball for 100 a turn. Drain the live ball here and the whole thing is void.

goals.title: Big Wow
goals.summary: With a ball trapped in the Centrifuge, pumping the flipper buttons throws it around the disc and pushes the jackpot up 100 at a time. Do it hard enough and the whole cabinet shakes. Every second you spend pumping is a second the live ball is unattended, which is the trade.
goals.reward: +100 per spin to the pending jackpot

steps.action: Trap a ball on the disc
steps.detail: The build window is twenty seconds long.
Cradle the live ball first. This is at its best stacked under another multiball you are already surviving.

goals.title: Super Spins
goals.summary: During Centrifuge Multiball, going back into the disc pays 15K per spin, and that rate climbs 1,250 every time you collect it. It is also multiplied by the best jackpot you have taken since the last Super Spin, so cash a triple first and the disc pays triple.

steps.detail: Collect a jackpot, then the double, then the triple while they are still lit.
The multiplier matches your best jackpot since the last collection, then drops back to 1x.

goals.title: Double And Triple Jackpots
goals.summary: Collect a Centrifuge jackpot and another shot lights briefly for a double. Take that and a triple lights for an even shorter moment. A collected triple counts as completing the multiball, so this ladder is how the middle lamp between the flippers gets lit.

steps.detail: The lit shot moves, so read the arrows rather than guessing.
Hesitate and the value falls all the way back to a single.
A triple jackpot marks Centrifuge Multiball complete.

goals.title: Collect The Evidence
goals.summary: Evidence is the gate to the biggest multiball on the machine. The Microscope loop lights Evidence at every major shot, and you need five pieces of one colour — red, green or blue. Values start at 600K and climb 100K per piece.
instructions: Shoot the Microscope loop early. Until you do, none of your other shots are banking anything toward the multiball.
Every major shot then carries an Evidence colour. Collecting from a shot changes that shot's colour rather than clearing it.
You need five of the same colour, so you may have to hit a shot two or three times to cycle it round to red, green or blue.
Later multiballs do not reset every shot to the same colour, which is deliberate — it forces you around the whole playfield instead of camping one ramp.
You cannot collect Evidence during Skull Multiball, which is why Skull and Microscope will not stack.
Once you have five, the Microscope area flashes and the loop starts the multiball.

goals.title: Microscope Multiball
goals.summary: The deep end of CSI: six stages and at least twenty-three shots with more than one ball alive. Start it at the Microscope loop, where the magnet holds your ball for study while a second is auto-plunged.
goals.reward: 275K jackpots climbing to a 5.5M mega jackpot

steps.action: Start it and take stage one
steps.detail: Five major shots light for 275K jackpots.

steps.action: Stage two and three at the loop
steps.detail: Two hits in either direction pays 550K doubles; hitting it in opposite directions pays 875K triples.
The right loop and the Morgue light with big arrows for 1,375K each.

steps.action: Stage five: fill the lamp grid
steps.detail: Fifteen shots across three rows of five, each paying a 550K double — roughly 7.5M if you complete the grid.
The Morgue for 5.5M, and Microscope Multiball is complete.

goals.title: Fingerprint Frenzy
goals.summary: Built purely out of spinner revolutions at the right spinner, 3K a spin. When it starts, every switch on the machine is worth 10K for twenty-five seconds — and both spinner lanes dump into the bumpers, which is a lot of switches in a hurry.

steps.detail: The display tracks how close you are.
Either spinner will feed the pocket, and every rattle in there is another 10K.

goals.title: Suspect Shakedown
goals.summary: The left spinner builds a face on the display at 3K per spin. Fifty spins completes it and starts a twenty-five second hunt worth 500K up front, with six major shots lit yellow. One of them is hiding the suspect and pays a million.

steps.detail: Fifty spins. Feeding the lane from the Fingerprint spinner side counts too.
Wrong shots still pay, starting at 300K and rising 100K each.
Whichever of the six is hiding him is worth a million.

goals.title: Ballistics
goals.summary: Collect six bullets to start a forty-second shootout. Five come off the bullet targets at 75K each — the fifth pays 250K — and the sixth is collected at the Lab saucer. The first time all six shots are lit at once; after that only one lights at a time.

steps.detail: 75K a target, 250K for the fifth. The upper-right pair needs the mini flipper.

steps.action: Take the sixth at the saucer
steps.detail: That starts the forty-second clock.
Awards start at 500K and climb 50K a shot to a 750K ceiling. Collecting them all ends the mode.

goals.title: DNA Drops And Lab Awards
goals.summary: Each DNA drop is 25K and clearing all three lights a Lab award at the saucer. In single-ball play that means extra ball, 4x bumpers, or a Special or extra ball lit at the outlanes. During any multiball it usually means another ball, up to four on the glass.
goals.reward: Extra ball, 4x bumpers or an added ball

steps.detail: Three drops on the far left rail, 25K each.
Lab awards do not stack, so cash one before you go clear the bank again.

goals.title: Spell C-S-I For Bonus
goals.summary: Three inlanes spell C-S-I for 100K and a bonus multiplier. Collecting the Lab award it lights adds another, and that in turn briefly lights the right loop stop for three more. The catch is that the whole thing has to be cashed at the saucer and none of it carries to the next ball.

steps.action: Lane change as the ball comes down
steps.detail: The flipper buttons move the lit letter — set it before the ball reaches the lane.
100K and one multiplier, plus a Lab award lit at the saucer.
Another multiplier, and the right loop stop lights briefly for three more.

goals.title: Build The Bumper Value
goals.summary: Bumpers reset to 3K per hit at the start of every ball, and each right loop adds 1K to that. It sounds trivial until you remember the bumper pocket is enclosed — a ball that gets in there rattles a long time, and the Photo award pays out whatever it earned.

steps.detail: Each pass adds 1K to every bumper hit for the rest of the ball.

steps.action: Send the ball to the pocket
steps.detail: A 4x bumpers Lab award multiplies whatever you have built.

goals.title: The Photo Award
goals.summary: As a ball leaves the bumper pocket it briefly lights a mini-flipper shot to the Morgue for a Photo award, and that award equals everything the bumpers just scored on that visit. Build the bumper value first and this quietly becomes one of the better shots on the machine.
goals.reward: Equal to the bumper points from that visit

steps.detail: The longer the ball stays in, the larger the pending award.

steps.action: Take the shot as the ball exits
steps.detail: The window is short and there is no fanfare warning you it is open.
You are paid whatever the bumpers scored on that trip.

goals.title: Stack Your Multiballs
goals.summary: Longer multiballs and larger jackpots come from running two at once, and CSI is specific about which pairs work. Skull stacks with Centrifuge. Centrifuge stacks with Microscope. Skull and Microscope cannot stack, because Evidence is switched off while the Skull is running.

steps.detail: Until the loop has lit Evidence, your ordinary shots are banking nothing toward the biggest multiball.

steps.action: Arm the Skull with ramp shots
steps.detail: Get the locks lit but hold off on completing them until you are ready to layer something on top.
Skull with Centrifuge is the easiest of the two workable stacks. Centrifuge with Microscope is where the biggest scores live.

steps.action: Layer a frenzy over the top
steps.detail: Frenzies and Ballistics are timed modes rather than multiballs, so they run alongside anything and double up whatever you are already shooting. Never try to hold Skull and Microscope together — Evidence does not count while the Skull is running.

goals.title: The 50 Million Shot
goals.summary: There is no traditional wizard mode. What there is instead: complete all three multiballs — the three lamps between the flippers track it — and the machine offers you a single shot worth fifty million.

steps.detail: That means reaching level four and taking the Morgue and right loop millions.
A collected triple jackpot is what marks it complete.
All six stages, ending with the 5.5M mega jackpot at the Morgue.

steps.action: Take the shot you are offered
steps.detail: Fifty million. Almost nobody sees this — treat the three lamps between the flippers as your scoreboard.

goals.title: Learn The Mini Flipper
goals.summary: Two of the five bullet targets and the entire AV Lab award set are only reachable from the mini flipper above the Lab saucer. Ignore it and you are playing a smaller machine than the one in front of you.
goals.reward: Access to the AV Lab and two bullets

steps.detail: Both spinner lanes run into the bumper pocket, and everything in the pocket ends up at the mini flipper.
The shot crosses the playfield to the top right. Practise it before you need it in Ballistics.
These two face left specifically for this flipper.

achievements.title: First On Scene
achievements.desc: Land the plunge in the Morgue for the skill shot.

achievements.title: Full Sample
achievements.desc: Clear the DNA drops and collect the Lab award at the saucer.

achievements.title: Print Match
achievements.desc: Spin up Fingerprint Frenzy at the right spinner.

achievements.title: Eyes Full
achievements.desc: Lock both balls in the Skull and start Skull Multiball.

achievements.title: Spun Up
achievements.desc: Count the Centrifuge down to zero and start its multiball.

achievements.title: Got Him
achievements.desc: Find the suspect during Suspect Shakedown for the million.

achievements.title: Say Cheese
achievements.desc: Collect a Photo award off the mini flipper as the ball leaves the bumpers.

achievements.title: Five Of A Colour
achievements.desc: Collect five matching pieces of Evidence and light Microscope Multiball.

achievements.title: Mega Jackpot
achievements.desc: Reach stage six of Microscope Multiball and take the 5.5M at the Morgue.

achievements.title: Two At Once
achievements.desc: Run Skull and Centrifuge, or Centrifuge and Microscope, at the same time.

achievements.title: Case Closed
achievements.desc: Complete all three multiballs and take the fifty million shot.

drills.title: Controlled Plunge To The Morgue
drills.text: Ease the plunge up the right wall so the ball drops into the Morgue instead of carrying past it. Overshoot and the ball runs into the Shakedown lane and dies in the bumpers, and the value you set here climbs all game.

drills.title: The Mini Flipper Diagonal
drills.text: Everything that leaves the bumper pocket arrives at the mini flipper, so use those balls to drill the diagonal across to the top right. The two right-hand bullet targets face left specifically for this flipper and the lower flippers cannot reach them cleanly.

drills.title: Thread The Ramp
drills.text: The only ramp on the machine is threaded past the right edge of the Centrifuge, with a bullet target standing just left of the disc entrance. Alternate ramp and Centrifuge from the left flipper and count how often a wide one clips that target instead.

drills.title: Cradle Before You Pump
drills.text: With a ball trapped on the disc you have twenty seconds to inflate the jackpot, and every second of pumping is a second the live ball is unattended. Cradle the live ball first, then pump — draining it in that window throws the whole build away.

drills.title: Catch The Photo Window
drills.text: Run the right loop a few times to build the bumper value, feed the pocket, and be ready on the mini flipper as the ball comes out. The Morgue lights briefly for a Photo award worth whatever the bumpers just scored, and nothing announces the window.

drills.title: Single, Double, Triple
drills.text: In Centrifuge Multiball take the jackpot, then the double, then the triple with no hesitation between them. The lit shot moves each time and any pause drops the value back to a single, so read the arrows on the way rather than after.

actionButton.how: This one arrived before Stern started fitting a button to the lockdown bar, so your controls are two flipper buttons, the start button and a manual plunger — the auto-launcher only handles the balls the machine adds itself. The mini flipper above the left flipper runs off a flipper button, not a control of its own.

howItPlays.objective: CSI turns the playfield into a crime lab where the Skull, the Centrifuge and the Microscope each guard their own multiball. Solve all three and the game hands you a single fifty-million shot at the Morgue as its case-closing reward.
loop: Run the Microscope loop early to switch Evidence on, because until it glows your other shots bank nothing toward the deepest multiball.
Ramp the Skull to light and stack its locks, spin the Centrifuge disc down to zero, and gather five matching pieces of Evidence to arm the Microscope.
Spell C-S-I across the return lanes and clear the DNA drops to stack bonus multipliers and Lab awards at the saucer.
Groove the mini flipper above the left flipper, the one clean route to the AV Lab and the two right-facing bullet targets.
Stack whichever multiballs are allowed to pair, then finish all three to unlock the fifty-million shot.

lights.name: C-S-I Return Lanes
lights.lit: The three return lanes spell C-S-I; a lit letter is one you still need, and the whole set is cashed at the Lab saucer rather than banked, so none of it survives into your next ball.

control.effect: a flipper tap shifts which C-S-I letter is lit, letting you drop the one you still owe into the return lane the ball is heading down
control.when: before the ball reaches the inlane

lights.then: Line the lit letter up, roll through to finish C-S-I for a bonus multiplier, then collect the Lab award it lights at the saucer for a second multiplier, which briefly opens the right-loop stop for three more.

lights.name: The Skull
lights.lit: Lamps at the Skull ramp mouth tell you whether a shot lights a lock or just returns the ball; a lit lock means the next ramp drops a ball into an eye socket.
lights.then: Load both eyes to start Skull Multiball, then climb its four-level ladder from yellow arrows up to million-point Morgue and right-loop shots. Every later Skull demands more ramps to relight each lock.

lights.name: Centrifuge
lights.lit: Feeding the disc spins the ball and pays down a spin debt shown on the display; reach zero and the Centrifuge arms as a lock.

control.effect: with a ball trapped on the disc, pumping both flipper buttons whips it around the Centrifuge and pushes the pending jackpot up a notch per spin

lights.then: Hit it again to trap a ball and serve a second, then spend the window inflating the jackpot -- but keep the loose ball cradled, since draining it there voids the whole build. Chase single, double and triple jackpots to complete it.

lights.name: Evidence & Microscope
lights.lit: Once the Microscope loop lights Evidence, every major shot carries a colored piece, and collecting from a shot rotates that shot's color rather than clearing it.
lights.then: Cycle five pieces of one color -- red, green or blue -- to flash the Microscope, then start its six-stage multiball at the loop, where a magnet studies your ball while a second launches. It climbs to a five-and-a-half-million mega jackpot at the Morgue.

lights.name: Ballistics Bullets
lights.lit: Six bullets arm Ballistics: five come off the standup bullet targets scattered around the layout and the sixth is taken at the Lab saucer.
lights.then: Collect all six -- the two right-facing ones need the mini flipper -- to start a timed shootout, then clear every flashing bullet as the awards climb to their ceiling. The first Ballistics lights the whole set at once; later ones light one bullet at a time.

lights.name: The Two Spinners
lights.lit: Each spinner feeds a timed mode: the right one builds Fingerprint Frenzy a few thousand per turn, the left one builds a suspect's face over fifty spins.
lights.then: Rip the right spinner to start a frenzy where every switch is worth ten thousand for a stretch, and both spinner lanes dump into the enclosed bumper pocket to cash it. Fill the left spinner's face to hunt the hiding suspect for a million.

lights.name: DNA Drops & Lab Awards
lights.lit: Clearing the three DNA drops on the far-left rail lights a Lab award waiting at the saucer.
lights.then: Cash it at the saucer for an extra ball, quadruple bumpers or a lit outlane special in single-ball play, or an added ball during any multiball. Lab awards never stack, so collect one before you rebuild the bank.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: A flipper tap slides the lit C-S-I letter along the return lanes; set the one you still owe under the inlane the ball is dropping toward, then roll through to complete C-S-I. That scores a bonus multiplier, and the Lab award it lights at the saucer adds a second, but it is all cashed there and carries nothing into your next ball.

scoring.text: Take the controlled Morgue plunge for a skill shot whose value climbs all game, then spell C-S-I on the return lanes and clear the DNA drops for early bonus multipliers and Lab awards. Groove the mini-flipper diagonal now, because Ballistics and the AV Lab both lean on it.

Get a multiball going and stack a legal partner: Skull pairs with Centrifuge, Centrifuge pairs with Microscope, but Skull and Microscope never mix because Evidence sleeps while the Skull is up. Layer a spinner frenzy over the top for cheap points.

Complete all three multiballs -- Skull to level four, a collected triple on the Centrifuge, and the Microscope through its mega jackpot -- to light a single fifty-million shot at the Morgue. The three lamps between the flippers are your scoreboard toward it.
